assessments.reasoning: The IEC catalogue block gives the exact base publication number and identifies its subject as Z formal specification notation. Its public abstract names syntax, type system and semantics as included scope.

challenge.method: Read the exact raw catalogue block and its beyond-scope paragraph. Compare the ISO indexed rendering, the separate IEC corrigendum record and the z-lang publisher README.
challenge.results: The numbered ISO rendering and IEC base catalogue identify the same formal notation. IEC separately numbers the 2007 corrigendum. The unrelated z-lang repository describes an educational programming language and its compiler. No standards clauses were inferred from either catalogue.

limitations: The original ISO route returned HTTP 403 over ordinary HTTPS. Its indexed rendering is contextual, and the directly acquired IEC block controls the identity claim only.
